result.callback_exclusion: Normal-return dispatcher holds job+0x2c across slot-2 callback, matching manager destruction lock.
result.scheduler_ownership: Registration increments job+8 before queue insertion; normal cancellation processing decrements after clearing job+0x30.
result.cancelled_completed_job: Finished queue at scheduler+0x140 consumes job+0x28 bit 0; selected removal clears request/state/owner and invokes slot 4 then drops scheduler reference.
result.cancelled_pending_job: Pending queue at scheduler+0x200 also consumes bit 0 before promotion to waiting state.
result.last_reference: Atomic decrement returns prior count; prior count <=1 invokes slot 1, which dispatches slot 0 with deletion flag 1.

limitations: Static normal-control-flow ownership, not live completion or bounded cancellation latency.
Queue locking helpers, dependency teardown internals, scheduler shutdown and exceptional exits are not exhaustively verified.
